notes.title: Black screen resolution.
notes.content:
- typo fixed
-----------

Hello there,

Thanks for your replies. 
Please try following steps to resolve the problem. 

1. For those who encountered blank dialogue boxes in the game. 
We guess it may be resolved by installing the font we use. 
So we provide the font here. 
Please install the font of your language and then restart the game. 

English: 
https://drive.google.com/file/d/0B6UCmQfXJzbRWWxMWFBQeVlCeGc/view?usp=sharing
Japanese:
https://drive.google.com/file/d/0B6UCmQfXJzbRclN3M0JhM3dsN2c/view?usp=sharing
Chinese:
https://drive.google.com/file/d/0B6UCmQfXJzbROTktZE01d1kyV0U/view?usp=sharing

2. Some brackets or empty boxes may appear in the text depending on your computer's encoding. These have to do with punctuation only and does not affect gameplay.


****
